prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm olive complexion, late 20s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, top bun copper red hair — full body mirror-polished copper liquid chrome fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid liquid chrome body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, a seamless liquid-metal chrome shell with a perfect mirror finish, reflecting the surroundings in sharp warped images that bend over every curve, hard bright white highlights and deep dark reflections side by side, smooth and seamless with no joints, nothing lying flat. Dense mirror surface — BLAZING flawless mirror copper chrome across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID deep red-brown and amber reflections warping over every curve, with sharp white highlights streaking along her sides, mirror-polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ankle fetter joined by its own short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, to one single huge black iron ring held low between her feet, so that the two ankle chains run from her two ankles and meet at that one ring. She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, hangs straight down the front of her body and is joined to that same ring between her feet, so that the neck chain and both ankle chains all meet at that one ring, the long chain hanging in a gentle slack curve. Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her feet a hand's width apart, her arms relaxed at her sides, the long chain hanging down the center of her body to the ring between her feet in view, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of the same copper chrome, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, made of the same copper chrome with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the figure — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her feet to the top of her head completely visible. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
